note: GAUNTLET boons (D-017). Drafted 1-of-3 after every won floor; they stack for the whole run. `seatMods` patches the PLAYER seat's Sim opts.seatMods (numeric fields add/multiply as marked).

boons.name: Sharpened

boons.name: Leech Stitch
boons.desc: Every hit you land heals 10% of its damage.

boons.name: The Rift's Favor
boons.desc: Start every fight with a pint already in the bag.
